long_biography.plain_text:
Grecian Hotels International appointed Greek-Cypriot hospitality executive Nicos Kounnas to its board in 2001, alongside Marinos Kounnas. The company belongs to a family-run group whose hotels span Ayia Napa, Protaras and London. Kounnas remains an active director.

His separate Estonian business centres on Pokardi Manor. Kounnas bought the neglected property in 2014 and began restoration two years later, converting it into The Manor Sports & Spa. Estonia's business register identifies him as the sole shareholder and management-board member of N&K Invest, whose main activity is hotel accommodation and whose secondary activity is restaurants and cafés.
